video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/17, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Next storm system 10/21-10/24 with snow for the West, but upon arrival temps are abnormally warm with high elevation freezing levels.  They do eventually drop to lower elevations with some snow generation.  Minor remnants of Simon roll through NM/AZ/CO between 10/18-10/19.  Another storm system possible on/after 10/26.
